learning_outcomes.text: Analyse measurement devices for temperature, position and force.
Demonstrate an understanding of the basic concepts of dynamic system response and closed loop control.
Develop models for simple dynamic plant.
Design controllers and analyse system performance.
Simulate control systems with appropriate software and assess system performance.

syllabus_topics: Temperature measurement: thermometers, thermistors and thermo-couples
Force and weight measurement: strain gauges and bridge circuit
Displacement measurement: potentiometers, LVDT (linear variable difference transformer)
P&ID Diagrams Introduction: control system structure including sensors, controllers, actuators and plants.
Matlab/Simulink Modelling & Simulation: introduce transfer function models for different plants, how to simulate a control system with Matlab/Simulink for system analysis and performance assessment.
Stability analysis: pole location method and Routh method
Time response analysis: characteristics for first order and second order systems, response to step and ramp input.
Controller design: design specification in time domain, functions of P, I and D control, empirical controller parameter setting method.
institution: Liverpool John Moores University — BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering
